content.focus: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) with an emphasis on medical practice implementation in the United States applicable worldwide.
content.guidelinePurpose: To improve quality of care and align with patients' interests, not replacing clinical judgment.
content.clinicalImplementation: Guidelines are effective when followed by both practitioners and patients. Emphasizes decision-making between clinicians and patients.
content.methodology: The AHA/ACC Joint Committee continually reviews and updates guidelines based on National Academy of Medicine standards.
content.modularFormat: Guidelines include recommendations, brief synopsis, and supporting text.
content.evidenceReview: Relies on evidence-based methodologies, including RCTs and non-randomized designs, to develop recommendations.
content.guidelineManagementAndTherapy: GDMT includes clinical evaluation, diagnostic testing, and treatment.
